name: J.G.Chemicals Ltd
title: J.G.Chemicals Ltd - 544138 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Zinc oxide utilisation in the late 70s (~77%) with Gujarat capacity due in H1 FY27; FY26 record revenue of INR972.9 cr but Q4 EBITDA margin only 10.26% as March raw-material and energy spikes hit before pass-through from 1 April.

utilisation.quote: the capacity utilization currently is about 77%. We can easily take this up to 86% to 87%

capex.quote: JG is itself in active capacity expansion mode to ensure that we have the capacity in place well before the demand wave arrives.

triggers.label: ZnO utilisation late 70s (~77%)
triggers.quote: the capacity utilization currently is about 77%. We can easily take this up to 86% to 87%

triggers.label: Dahej capacity add; Naidupeta debottleneck by Dec 2026
triggers.quote: we expect that by December 2026, we'll have completely debottlenecked this facility

triggers.label: Cost pass-through from 1 April 2026
triggers.quote: all of these incremental costs, including higher freight, energy, and other ancillary costs, have been transparently passed on to all our customers with effect from 1st April 2026

triggers.label: Volume growth mid-teens in current quarter
triggers.quote: even for the current quarter, we've been in the mid-teens

guidance.quote: higher value-added products would help increase the blended margins to the 13% to 14% range
we are confident of achieving double-digit volume growth, this is what we had outlined earlier as well

guidance.value: 35% to 40% in first six months; 65% to 70% in FY28
guidance.quote: we should get to about 35% to 40% range for that period. And for the full year which is the next financial year which is FY28, we should get to about 65% to 70%
we expect that by December 2026, we'll have completely debottlenecked this facility

prior_guidance_check.quote: The company was able to achieve double-digit volume growth in its key segments on a full year basis

red_flags.label: Q4 margin 10.26% despite record revenue; March cost spike absorbed
red_flags.quote: the margins in Q4 were in the 10.26% range, EBITDA margin as a percentage of revenue from operation

red_flags.label: Zinc sulphate at ~60% utilisation
red_flags.quote: The zinc sulphate business, which has gradually been growing, is today running at approximately 60% of the installed capacity.

evasions.topic: Quantum of inventory gain in Q4
evasions.quote: So, you see ours is a rolling inventory and we keep buying every month and we keep selling every month.
As a company policy, we do not disclose volume numbers and we've mentioned this before as well.
We have already mentioned the utilization rates for the zinc oxide in the late 70s and the zinc sulphate in the 60s.
